article.story: Central Michigan (5-5) at Buffalo (7-3), Nov. 18 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Buffalo by 2.5. Against the spread: Buffalo 6-4, Central Michigan 6-4. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats Buffalo Offense Overall: 345.7 yards per game (101st in FBS) Passing: 164.6 yards per game (127th) Rushing: 181.1 yards per game (42nd) Scoring: 24.3 points per game (93rd) Buffalo Defense Overall: 369.5 yards per game (79th in FBS) Passing: 211.2 yards per game (67th) Rushing: 158.3 yards per game (90th) Scoring: 24.1 points per game (64th) Central Michigan Offense Overall: 317.4 yards per game (125th in FBS) Passing: 126.6 yards per game (134th) Rushing: 190.8 yards per game (28th) Scoring: 20.6 points per game (119th) Central Michigan Defense Overall: 325.8 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 164.7 yards per game (9th) Rushing: 161.1 yards per game (91st) Scoring: 22.1 points per game (47th) Central Michigan ranks 127th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 45.5% of third downs. Buffalo is 112th in the FBS with a -5 turnover margin, compared to Central Michigan's 43rd-ranked +3 margin. Buffalo is 107th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 88.9% of trips. Central Michigan's red zone offense ranks 31st, scoring on 90% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Buffalo Passing: Jason Wright, 1,393 yards, 10 TDs, 6 INTs, 48.6 completion percentage Rushing: Messiah Burch, 1,110 yards on 196 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Chance Morrow, 696 yards on 54 catches, 9 TDs Central Michigan Passing: Jadyn Glasser, 743 yards, 3 TDs, 3 INTs, 59.8 completion percentage Rushing: Angel Flores, 618 yards on 128 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Langston Lewis, 379 yards on 24 catches, 2 TDs Last game Buffalo defeated Ball State 28-7 on Nov. 11. Wright led Buffalo with 48 yards on 5-of-14 passing (35.7%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Burch carried the ball 31 times for 209 yards and scored two touchdowns. Clint Walker put up 30 yards on one catch. Central Michigan beat Sacramento State 28-7 on Nov. 11. Glasser led Central Michigan with 105 yards on 11-of-19 passing (57.9%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for 33 yards. Nicholas Woodford carried the ball 23 times for 119 yards. Nasir Williams put up 57 yards on three catches. Next game Buffalo plays at Akron on Nov. 27. Central Michigan plays at Ball State on Nov. 28.
